# King Fast Food

## About

King Fast Food is a fast food restaurant in Sarandë, Albania, specializing in gyros, pita, döner, grilled meats, and rotisserie chicken. Open every day from 10 AM to 5 AM (next day) with daily phone delivery across Sarandë. Known for big portions, fast service (most orders ready in under 10 minutes), and fair prices.

## Locations

* Rruga Ismail Qemali, Sarandë 9701, Albania

## Service Area

Sarandë and surrounding areas including Ksamil, Butrint, Çukë, Gjashtë, Lëkurës, and central Sarandë neighborhoods. Phone delivery throughout Sarandë city.

## Key Facts

* Google rating: 4.9 stars (88+ reviews)
* Open every day of the year, including holidays
* Most orders ready in under 10 minutes
* Price range: budget-friendly (300 – 3,000 Lek per item)
* Cuisine: Albanian / Mediterranean fast food, gyros, pita, döner, grilled meats, rotisserie chicken
* Cash and card accepted
* Dine-in, takeaway, and phone delivery

## What Makes Us Different

Big portions for fair prices — most sandwiches and wraps under 800 Lek, full plates under 1,200 Lek. Fresh meat grilled to order on a real charcoal/rotisserie grill, not pre-cooked. Open until 5am every single night, including weekends and holidays, with delivery the whole time.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How much does a meal at King Fast Food cost?
A: Wraps and sandwiches start at 300 Lek (hot dog) and most are 350 – 800 Lek. Full plates and platters run 700 – 3,000 Lek. The Mixed Grill Platter for sharing is 3,000 Lek.

Q: Do you deliver in Sarandë?
A: Yes. We deliver across Sarandë every day from 10 AM to 5 AM (next day). Call +355 69 748 0902 to order.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Every day, including weekends and holidays, from 10 AM to 5 AM (next day).

Q: How long does an order take?
A: Most orders are ready in under 10 minutes for dine-in or takeaway, even during busy nights.

Q: Where are you located?
A: Rruga Ismail Qemali, Sarandë 9701, Albania. Use Google Maps: https://share.google/GV6fE8da4Rzv1O4Ai

Q: Do you have vegetarian options?
A: Yes — we offer salads, fries, cheese pitas, and vegetarian wraps. Ask when you order.

Q: Do you take card payments?
A: Yes, we accept both cash and card.

Q: What's your most popular dish?
A: The pork and chicken gyro wraps (Sufllaqe), the Arabic pita, and the whole rotisserie chicken are customer favorites. The Mixed Grill Platter is the top pick for groups.
